SELECT FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND ORDER BY created_at ASC, story_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_story WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId, COUNT(s.story_id) AS storyCount FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN ultary_story s ON s.user_no = u.user_no AND s.is_deleted = 0
WHERE n.requester_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND n.status = 'ACCEPTED' GROUP BY u.user_no, u.nickname ORDER BY MAX(s.created_at) DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (requester_user_no = #{userNoA} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoB}) OR (requester_user_no = #{userNoB} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoA}) )
